release_notes: Incoming postbacks are now logged (ORB-001): every postback the tracker receives is recorded with its payload before status mapping, so lost or rejected conversions can be investigated instead of guessed; the postback route and the conversion pixel path were repaired along the way. Conversion statuses that no rule maps are no longer forced into a guess — Facebook and TikTok engines check custom mappings first, unmapped statuses surface in a new Conversion Types Settings section, and a mapping defined later is applied retroactively, reclassifying existing conversions. LeadForge no longer fabricates subids for leads with no click context: the subid is verified against the clicks table, and a lead with a stale or missing subid is rejected and logged instead of being sent to the network with an invented id. Routing is consolidated — router.php is gone, index.php is the sole front controller and carries the disabled-domain (404) and admin-access guards. The server's public IP now has a single source of truth instead of per-feature detection, and HTTPS detection honours CF-Visitor, so Cloudflare Flexible SSL no longer traps the panel in a redirect loop. Analytics queries got covering indexes on clicks, synchronous geo enrichment from external APIs is off the click path, and landing assets are handed to nginx via X-Accel-Redirect — a landing with 30 assets no longer ties up 30 PHP workers. AN EXISTING NGINX SERVER NEEDS `sudo php /var/www/orbitra/cli/nginx_sync.php` ONCE for the asset hand-off; Apache installs need nothing manual.
